description: This file is part of the SuiteCRM installation process, generating an environment check HTML page that verifies server configurations, required PHP extensions, and system environment settings before proceeding with installation.

classes.name: ImapHandlerFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and checking the availability of IMAP handlers used in the suiteCRM environment.

classes.name: UploadStream
classes.description: Utility class managing upload stream security, particularly related to Suhosin security extension.

methods.name: areAllHandlersAvailable
methods.description: Checks if all necessary IMAP handlers are available in the current environment.

methods.name: getSuhosinStatus
methods.description: Returns whether Suhosin security extension allows use of upload:// stream.

methods.name: getRunningUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current web server user executing the script.

methods.name: get_sugar_config_defaults
methods.description: Retrieves default configuration settings for SuiteCRM.

methods.name: return_module_language
methods.description: Returns language-specific strings for a given module.

methods.name: get_language_header
methods.description: Returns appropriate HTML language header attributes based on current language settings.

methods.name: is_windows
methods.description: Detects if the operating environment is Windows.

methods.name: return_bytes
methods.description: Converts PHP ini size values (like '8M') into byte integers.
